changeSet.comment: Supermarkt-Angebote: Urteil je Produkt und Angebots-Fingerabdruck.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE grocery_match ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, product_id BIGINT NOT NULL, fingerprint CHAR(64) NOT NULL, verdict VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, reason_kind VARCHAR(20) NULL, reason VARCHAR(200) NULL, decided_by VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, decided_at DATETIME NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT uq_grocery_match_product_fingerprint UNIQUE (product_id, fingerprint), CONSTRAINT fk_grocery_match_product FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES grocery_product (id) ON DELETE CASCADE )
